label: RUCKUS ICX 7150-24
description: RUCKUS ICX 7150-24 stackable access switch: 24x 1G RJ-45 downlinks, 2x 1G RJ-45 uplinks, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplink/stacking ports, no PoE, 180 Gbps switching capacity.
notes: Family datasheet: 24+2 x 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ-45 and 4x 1/10 GbE uplink/stacking SFP/SFP+, no PoE; switching capacity 180 Gbps on the standard 7150 column of the model table. Port numbering follows the hardware guide: downlinks on slot 1 (1/1/1-1/1/24), the two RJ-45 uplinks on slot 2 (1/2/1-1/2/2), the SFP+ cages on slot 3 (1/3/1-1/3/4). The 10G rate is licence-gated - the PoD licensing guide names 1/3/1-1/3/4 as the licence-gated 10G ports - so the spec models the SFP+ cage and both rates rather than assuming a licence is fitted. Out-of-band 1G RJ-45 management port plus an RS-232 RJ-45 console port; the second, USB Type-C console port is not modelled because the engine has no USB interface.
